Overview

Huaraz is a city in AN with a population of 130,000. The adventure sports capital of Peru, a highland city surrounded by the stunning Cordillera Blanca mountains. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
